podcastListening.spotifyDefinition: Podcast audio and video playback events lasting at least 30 seconds. Repeat starts can count again; these are not completed episodes. Same-account exact duplicate events were removed before aggregation. Making Sense public and subscriber feeds are grouped as one show.
podcastListening.appleDefinition: Episodes with playback evidence in the Apple Podcasts snapshot, 2023–2025. This is a count of episode records, not playback starts, and is shown separately.
podcastListening.coverage: Shows with qualifying Spotify listens or Apple playback evidence, plus the existing curation. Explicit music-upload collections are excluded. Podcasts are ordered by Spotify listens, then Apple episode records where Spotify has no matched history. Missing counts are not zero.
